workspace_entitlements_period_order_chec.name: workspace_entitlements_period_order_check
workspace_entitlements_period_order_chec.value: "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_started_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_ends_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_started_at" <= "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_ends_at"

workspace_entitlements_pending_plan_pair.name: workspace_entitlements_pending_plan_pair_check
workspace_entitlements_pending_plan_pair.value: ("workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_key" IS NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_effective_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_key" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_effective_at" IS NOT NULL)

billing_transactions_vat_consistency_che.name: billing_transactions_vat_consistency_check
billing_transactions_vat_consistency_che.value:
(
        NOT "billing_transactions"."vat_enabled"
        AND "billing_transactions"."applied_vat_rate_basis_points" = 0
        AND "billing_transactions"."vat_amount_minor" = 0
        AND "billing_transactions"."tax_mode" = 'disabled'
      ) OR (
        "billing_transactions"."vat_enabled"
        AND "billing_transactions"."tax_mode" = 'exclusive'
      )

trades_exited_after_entered_check.name: trades_exited_after_entered_check
trades_exited_after_entered_check.value: "trades"."exited_at" IS NULL OR "trades"."entered_at" IS NULL OR "trades"."exited_at" >= "trades"."entered_at"

trades_actual_price_shape_check.name: trades_actual_price_shape_check

trades_planned_price_shape_check.name: trades_planned_price_shape_check

trades_planned_money_check.name: trades_planned_money_check
trades_planned_money_check.value:
("trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NULL OR "trades"."planned_risk_minor" > 0)
        AND ("trades"."planned_reward_minor" IS NULL OR "trades"."planned_reward_minor" >= 0)
        AND ("trades"."planned_reward_minor" IS NULL OR "trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL)

trades_plan_minimum_check.name: trades_plan_minimum_check
trades_plan_minimum_check.value:
("trades"."planned_entry" IS NOT NULL AND "trades"."planned_stop" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL

trades_chart_attachment_check.name: trades_chart_attachment_check
trades_chart_attachment_check.value:
(
        "trades"."chart_attachment_storage_key" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."chart_attachment_uploaded_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "trades"."chart_attachment_storage_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."chart_attachment_uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

trades_system_status_consistency_check.name: trades_system_status_consistency_check
trades_system_status_consistency_check.value:
(
        "trades"."system_status" = 'pending'
        AND "trades"."system_cost_r" = 0
        AND "trades"."system_resolution_kind" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exited_at" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_resolved_at" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_r" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_outcome" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "trades"."system_status" = 'resolved'
        AND "trades"."system_cost_r" >= 0
        AND "trades"."system_exited_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" <> 'setup_invalidated'
        AND "trades"."system_resolved_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."system_r" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."system_outcome" IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          (
            "trades"."system_resolution_kind" = 'price_exit'
            AND "trades"."planned_entry" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_stop" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" IS NULL
          ) OR (
            "trades"."system_resolution_kind" = 'money_target'
            AND "trades"."planned_entry" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_stop" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_reward_minor" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_r" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" = "trades"."planned_r"
            AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" = 'target_hit'
          ) OR (
            "trades"."system_resolution_kind" = 'money_stop'
            AND "trades"."planned_entry" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_stop" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" = -1
            AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" = 'stop_hit'
          ) OR (
            "trades"."system_resolution_kind" = 'money_break_even'
            AND "trades"."planned_entry" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_stop" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" = 0
            AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" = 'break_even_rule'
          ) OR (
            "trades"."system_resolution_kind" = 'money_custom'
            AND "trades"."planned_entry" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_stop" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."planned_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" = 'manual_system_valid_exit'
          )
        )
      ) OR (
        "trades"."system_status" = 'no_trade'
        AND "trades"."system_cost_r" = 0
        AND "trades"."system_resolution_kind" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exit_price" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_gross_r_input" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exited_at" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_exit_reason" = 'setup_invalidated'
        AND "trades"."system_resolved_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."system_r" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."system_outcome" IS NULL
      )

trades_status_consistency_check.name: trades_status_consistency_check
trades_status_consistency_check.value:
(
        "trades"."status" = 'planned'
        AND "trades"."actual_result_mode" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_entry" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_initial_stop" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_initial_risk_minor" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."entered_at" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_exit" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."net_pnl_minor" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."exited_at" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_r" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."trader_outcome" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "trades"."status" = 'open'
        AND "trades"."actual_result_mode" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."entered_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_exit" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."net_pnl_minor" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."exited_at" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_r" IS NULL
        AND "trades"."trader_outcome" IS NULL
        AND (
          (
            "trades"."actual_result_mode" = 'price'
            AND "trades"."actual_entry" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."actual_initial_stop" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."actual_initial_risk_minor" IS NULL
          ) OR (
            "trades"."actual_result_mode" = 'money'
            AND "trades"."actual_initial_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
      ) OR (
        "trades"."status" = 'closed'
        AND "trades"."actual_result_mode" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."entered_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."exited_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."actual_r" IS NOT NULL
        AND "trades"."trader_outcome" IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          (
            "trades"."actual_result_mode" = 'price'
            AND "trades"."actual_entry" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."actual_initial_stop" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."actual_initial_risk_minor" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."net_pnl_minor" IS NULL
            AND "trades"."actual_exit" IS NOT NULL
          ) OR (
            "trades"."actual_result_mode" = 'money'
            AND "trades"."actual_initial_risk_minor" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trades"."net_pnl_minor" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
      ) OR (
        "trades"."status" = 'canceled'
      )

trade_exits_result_present_check.name: trade_exits_result_present_check
trade_exits_result_present_check.value: "trade_exits"."exit_price" IS NOT NULL OR "trade_exits"."realized_pnl_minor" IS NOT NULL

mistake_types_tenancy_check.name: mistake_types_tenancy_check
mistake_types_tenancy_check.value: ("mistake_types"."is_system" AND "mistake_types"."workspace_id" IS NULL) OR (NOT "mistake_types"."is_system" AND "mistake_types"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

emotion_types_tenancy_check.name: emotion_types_tenancy_check
emotion_types_tenancy_check.value: ("emotion_types"."is_system" AND "emotion_types"."workspace_id" IS NULL) OR (NOT "emotion_types"."is_system" AND "emotion_types"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

platform_admins_revoked_by_requires_revo.name: platform_admins_revoked_by_requires_revoked_at
platform_admins_revoked_by_requires_revo.value: "platform_admins"."revoked_by_admin_id" IS NULL OR "platform_admins"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

admin_audit_log_actor_invariant_check.name: admin_audit_log_actor_invariant_check
admin_audit_log_actor_invariant_check.value: ("admin_audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'platform_admin' AND "admin_audit_log"."actor_admin_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("admin_audit_log"."actor_kind" = 'system' AND "admin_audit_log"."actor_admin_id" IS NULL)
